Fix for P2P AU Test failures. The problem was that depending on when the test was ran, it would pass or fail. If it followed a test that did a delta update it passed since the payload signature would be correct and setting max_p2p_attempts > 10 would result in update_engine preventing any further attempts. However, if the payload signature didn't match it would reset all state (including p2p attempts) and the update would succeed. This CL copies the payload signature from host 1 -> 2 so that we can just edit the pref files to get into the state we need.
